rows.label: tlk70000034_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey! Have you built a trusting
relationship with someone important to
you?

rows.label: tlk70000034_01_msg0002
rows.name:
For example, Blades and Drivers can
grow closer as they fight together and
complete requests side by side.

rows.label: tlk70000034_01_msg0003
rows.name:
After all, a shared action is
worth far more than a thousand
words could ever express...

rows.label: tlk70000034_01_msg0004
rows.name:
But how do I earn the trust of the one
I love? What can I do for a woman who
doesn't believe in love?

rows.label: tlk70000034_01_msg0005
rows.name:
Ah, this sweet pain that makes me want
to tear at my chest! This is... love!!
